newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Valley sees charge in March qtr.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Valley sees charge in March qtr.

text.p: Silicon Valley Group Inc said Friday it would record a pre-tax charge of $33.0 million against earnings for its fiscal second quarter, ending March 31.
The company said it expects to amortize the remainder of the charge over future periods.
The charge is related to the $3 million purchase of International Business Machines Corp's entire six percent interest in SVG Lithography Systems Inc, a unit of Silicon Valley Group.
As a result of the deal, Silicon Valley Group said it will own substantially all of the voting securities of the photolithography unit.

Also, it said it had satisfied in full its royalty payment obligation of $38 million to IBM in exchange for $23 million of Silicon Valley Group products, 489,296 of its shares valued at $10 million, and $5 million cash.
Silicon Valley Group makes automated wafer processing equipment for the semiconductor industry.
